motion.indexDomain: native global IBM palette indices; independent of display RGB/palette fade
motion.matching: Require exact values at all witness coordinates. Multiple matches are explicitly equivalent original frames. If occluded or absent, return unknown; do not pick nearest. Full-frame SHA256 may confirm a match when no UI/cursor overlays cover the crop.

limits: Factory uses native frame0 only; Mentat playback uses actual indexed phase witnesses.
Whole paintings preserve source subject/camera while interpreting fine illustrative details; literal per-pixel photo recovery is not claimed.
Homeworld surface art is newly interpreted; native phase count/order, globe envelopes and source-index identity remain authoritative. Rotation uses newly painted texturemaps, not original RGB.
All46 ordinary unit/structure, Mentat/help, homeworld and scenario briefing/win/loss preview resources are covered; intro/finale WSA cinematics remain separately owned.
